scope_note: Assignment-focused film: only Assignment 6 files are explained; other files are excluded with reasons. --game is the git archive of 41a6b8b in _scratch/src (LF line endings, as committed). The play recording and the film's own fixture captures live outside the game (SOURCES.md).

components.explanation: Effect A, cover hit burst: 3 x CPUParticles2D (Flash, Debris, Dust) under one Node2D that frees itself on Dust.finished; fired from cover.gd take_hit() line 40 via main.gd spawn_cover_burst(); the intent block, r0/r1 fixture strips, R3 (Debris colour_ramp, strip-driven), Claude's reading/prediction/comparison, the student's verdict, the retrigger preview and the student's play recording.

Effect B, damage smoke: GPUParticles2D + ParticleProcessMaterial; follow() maps health/max_health to emitting and amount_ratio (on at <= 0.6, wreck 1.0), called from tank.gd; emission/process/draw settings; turbulence; r0/r1 strips; R5 (initial velocity 20/40 -> 50/80) driven by the in-game lump; the strip reading the student overruled; start/stop/pause.
The two particle textures, drawn by code (tools/make_particle_textures.gd): chip_6.png and soft_dot_32.png, with their import settings and credits; no downloaded or AI textures.

Godot's generated process shader from B's ParticleProcessMaterial: line 232 (start speed between initial_velocity_min/max = 50/80) and line 447 (turbulence blends velocity 10-20 % toward the noise direction every step), which explains the lump; LANGUAGE-NOTES A6.

Headless tests and their limits: config 128/128 and 76/76; two mutations, each exit 1 (Godot 3 name ignored silently); state 82 and 81 at 30/60/144 incl. two hits 0.317 s apart; the property probe; nothing drawn is proven headless.

Prices against the budget: price_measure.gd medians headless (A +0.074 ms, B -0.009) and windowed GPU on the RTX 3060 (A +0.023, B +0.077), drift 0.020/0.005; the agent's cost_particles.gd reading 6.90 ms everywhere (1/144 s); the price scene (keys 0-3, F9 vsync); FPS 143-144, capped.
The record: the brief and revisions R1-R5, agent mistakes the student caught, problems the agent caught in the brief, contributions, the source revision.
